sources.excerpt: Tour Bender — Union Tube Transistor Welcome Shop Dealers Buzz Contact Welcome Shop Dealers Buzz Contact Union Tube Transistor is based in East Vancouver, BC Canada. We strive for best practices in our building of musical equipment, pursuing ease of use in durable, repairable products. Our pursuit of great tone is its own reward. ← Back to Shop Tour Bender Tour Bender from $190.00 The Tour Bender is a silicon version of our Sone Bender. This unit is made with silicon transistors, providing a less temperamental version of this classic fuzz circuit. Like the Sone Bender, the Tour Bender takes aim at creating the legendary 60s tone of the Tone Bender and giving it an ability to clean up like a Fuzz Face, combining the best of both classics in a modern, reliable device. In addition to adding a tighter, more modern tone in comparison to the Germanium transistors in the Sone Bender, the silicon gain stages in the Tour Bender are much less sensitive to temperature fluctuations, delivering the same saturated tones in frigid midwest basement venues and simmering summer festival stages alike. Two simple controls for gain and volume let you set both the timbre and output level independently, ensuring the perfect tone and volume for your needs. If you're looking for reliable access to classic fuzz tone, the Tour Bender from Union Tube Transistor is the perfect choice. Draw is 10mA. Deluxe version has a wooden box, bandana, and laser engraved badge. Bean Counter version has a silkscreened graphic made to look like the badge, and no special packaging.
